input_study_scope.scope: Государственное и парламентское руководство, заметные отраслевые управленцы, столица и провинции, легальная и ограниченная в участии оппозиция, эмиграция и явно обозначенные международные дипломаты. Целевая выборка ролей, не рейтинг известности.

purpose: Improve direct measurement coverage for all excluded actors on the previous common8 variables, and all42 on Russia; compare imputation methods separately. No factor-driven new scores.
rules: No overwrite of observed values; any source correction is separate and explicit
No evidence-free zero or antipode completion
Ordinal1..2 for narrow direct manifestation;3 requires distinct coherent episodes
Public action is not inferred private sympathy; preserve institutional capacity
Source-coverage thresholds unchanged; imputed cells remain unknown in canonical ratings
Targeted collection is conditional on previous coverage and must be disclosed; no claim of confirmatory sampling
